configUnavailable: Verification settings could not be loaded. Submission is blocked to protect your account. Please retry.

challenge.label: Human verification
challenge.verified: Challenge completed; the server will verify it on submission
challenge.unavailable: Verification could not load or failed. Retry and check your connection and browser settings.
challenge.privacy: Cloudflare provides verification and receives your browser IP address and security signals.

admin.title: Human verification
admin.intro: Configure Cloudflare Turnstile Managed, save a draft, and test sign-in and registration separately before enabling protection.
admin.configurationUnavailable: Server encryption is unavailable. Saving, testing, and activation are blocked. Contact your server administrator.
admin.stale: The configuration changed or its tests expired. Refresh status and review it again. Unsaved inputs are kept; no write is retried automatically.
admin.hostnameHint: One hostname per line, without a protocol, port, or path
admin.secretHint: Leave blank to keep the configured secret. The input is cleared after a successful save.
admin.clearSecretHint: Secrets can only be cleared while protection is disabled. Configure a secret and test again afterward.
admin.testHint: Test the saved draft on a configured hostname. Both tests must pass and remain valid before activation. Saving changes clears previous test results.
admin.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save the draft before testing or activating it.
admin.privacy: Verification shares your browser IP address, User-Agent, and security and interaction signals with Cloudflare.
admin.legacyRisk: I acknowledge that the unchanged legacy frontend cannot sign in or register while verification is enabled. Reverting to it requires an administrator to explicitly disable verification and accept the reduced protection.
admin.v1Risk: I acknowledge that password-based API Token issuance through /api/v1/tokens is not protected by this verification. The existing Lsky v1 protocol remains compatible.
admin.disableWarning: Native sign-in and registration will no longer require verification. Existing password checks and rate limits remain. Disable protection?

notices.saved: Draft saved. Complete both verification tests.
notices.activated: The tested configuration is now active.
